name: Expert report weak points
description: Find the assumptions, data gaps and methodology problems in an expert report, each tied to the page and line, for a Daubert-style (N.J.R.E. 702) challenge or cross outline.

steps.title: Read the report
steps.instructions: List every factual assumption the expert relies on, every data source, and every conclusion that is not tied to a stated methodology. Cite the line for each.

steps.title: Check assumptions against the record
steps.instructions: For each assumption, find record facts that support or contradict it. Flag conclusions that may be a net opinion: bare conclusions unsupported by factual evidence or other data.

rubric.text: Every weak point cites the report line and the record fact that undercuts it.

author: Community sample
